title.zh: Crypto stocks slide after CLARITY Act fails to advance in Senate
title.en: Crypto stocks slide after CLARITY Act fails to advance in Senate

current_state.zh: Crypto-linked equities sold off sharply, with Circle and Coinbase down about 10%, after the US Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act market-structure bill.
